verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for WorkOS, since its SDKs, CLI tooling, and hosted service could plausibly collect usage data and offer controls over it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, either in the SDKs (workos-node, Python, iOS) or in the platform. Audit logs, Vault, and BYOK are adjacent privacy and security features and earn no credit here.
